name: Shraen Graveknight AP OLD
source: Pathfinder #155: Lord of the Black Sands

items.name: Hand Crossbow
items.description: Sometimes referred to as an alley bow by rogues or ruffians, this small crossbow fires small bolts that are sometimes used to deliver poison to the target. It's small enough to be shot one-handed, but it still requires two hands to load.

items.name: Main-Gauche
items.description: This parrying dagger features a robust guard to protect the wielder's hand.

items.name: Rapier
items.description: The rapier is a long and thin piercing blade with a basket hilt. It is prized among many as a dueling weapon.

items.name: Elven Chain (Standard-Grade)
items.description:
Elven chain is a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Chain Shirt] made of dawnsilver that glitters in even the faintest light. Because it's constructed with small, supple rings, it has no check penalty.

Created by elven artisans employing ancient crafting techniques, elven chain is exceptionally quiet. Unlike other chain shirts-even other dawnsilver chain shirts-elven chain does not have the noisy trait. This suit of armor can be etched with runes like any other dawnsilver chain shirt.

Craft Requirements The initial raw materials must include dawnsilver worth at least 3,125 sp.

savenote: +1 status bonus to all saves vs. magic effects, +2 status bonus to all saves vs. mental effects

defensiveAbilities.name: Attack of Opportunity
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Rejuvenation
defensiveAbilities.description:
When a graveknight is destroyed, its armor rebuilds its body over the course of 1d10 days-or more quickly if the armor is worn by a living host. If the body is destroyed before then, the process restarts.

A graveknight can only be permanently destroyed by obliterating its armor (such as with Disintegrate), transporting it to the Forge of Creation, or throwing it into the heart of a volcano.

defensiveAbilities.name: Sacrilegious Aura
defensiveAbilities.description: 30 feet. When a creature in the aura uses a vitality spell or ability, the graveknight automatically attempts to counteract it, with a counteract modifier of +24.

defensiveAbilities.name: Status Bonus to Saves
defensiveAbilities.description:
+1 status bonus to all saves vs. magic effects.

+2 status bonus to all saves vs. mental effects.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Devastating Blast
offensiveAbilities.description:
The graveknight unleashes a 30ft Cone of energy. Creatures in the area take 8d12 Cold Damage damage (Basic DC 36 Reflex Saving Throw save).

The graveknight can use this ability once every 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Graveknight's Curse
offensiveAbilities.description:
This curse affects anyone who wears a graveknight's armor for at least 1 hour.

Saving Throw DC 36 Will Saving Throw save

Onset 1 hour

Stage 1 Doomed 1 and cannot remove the armor (1 day)

Stage 2 Doomed 2, the creature's Speed is reduced by 10, and cannot remove the armor (1 day)

Stage 3 dies and transforms into the armor's graveknight.

Effect: Graveknight's Curse

offensiveAbilities.name: Heart-Seeking Strike
offensiveAbilities.description: The Shraen graveknight Steps once then Strikes with its rapier. A creature damaged by the attack must attempt a DC 36 Fortitude Saving Throw save. On a failure, the creature takes 4d6 Bleed Damage. On a critical failure, the attack pierces the creature's heart, and the creature dies.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Draw
offensiveAbilities.description: The Shraen graveknight draws a weapon, then Strikes with it.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ruinous Weapons
offensiveAbilities.description:
At the time of its creation, a graveknight chooses one of the following energy types that was relevant to its life or death: acid, cold, electricity, or fire.

Any weapon the graveknight wields gains the effects of the caustic, frost, shock, or flaming weapon rune, respectively, in addition to a +1 striking weapon rune.

If the graveknight is 14th level or higher, its weapons instead gain the effects of the greater versions of both of these runes.

offensiveAbilities.name: Weapon Master
offensiveAbilities.description: The graveknight has access to the critical specialization effects of any weapons it wields.

cantrips.name: Dancing Lights
cantrips.description: You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

lv2spells.name: Faerie Fire (At Will)
lv2spells.description: All creatures in the area when you cast the spell are limned in colorful, heatless fire of a color of your choice for the duration. Visible creatures can't be Concealed while affected by faerie fire. If the creatures are Invisible, they are Concealed while affected by faerie fire, rather than being Undetected.

lv4spells.name: Darkness (At Will)
lv4spells.description:
You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as Concealed.
